name: v0.3.0
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at v0.3.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Features
* feat(tui): stream replies, cancel tasks, and handle input-required by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/98
* feat: send non-text parts (files and structured data) by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/111
* feat: implement ListTasks across service, CLI, and MCP by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/112
* feat: list and delete push notification configs by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/113
* feat: implement GetExtendedAgentCard by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/114
* feat: attach SendMessageConfiguration to outgoing messages by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/115
* feat: negotiate transport instead of hardcoding JSON-RPC by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/116
* feat: support HTTP Basic and OpenID Connect security schemes by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/117
* feat: support A2A extensions by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/118
### Fixes
* fix: harden task listing against partial and out-of-range results by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/120
* fix: show validation error messages instead of a blank Error: by @jayeeebee in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/134
* fix: forward attachments to the agent on send and stream by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/125
* fix: look up the task's single push config when no ID is given by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/127
* fix: read v1.0 push notification payloads and allow requiring a token by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/128
* fix: report the protocol version of cards that mix v0.3 and v1.0 shapes by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/129
* fix(tui): stop the second reply of a session crashing the send worker by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/130
* fix(tui): save Basic and OIDC servers in a form that loads again by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/138
* fix(cli): report agent protocol errors without a traceback by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/141
* fix(tui): warn once about an unresolved server secret and open its scheme by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/142
* fix: resolve a URL attachment's media type when its name gives none by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/143
### Security
* fix(security): only send credentials to the configured origin by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/126
### Documentation
* docs: cover everything landed since v0.2.0 by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/132
* docs: document the generated agent skill and shape release notes by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/144
### Dependencies
* build(deps): bump urllib3 to 2.8.0 by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/133
* build(deps): bump mcp to 1.30.0 by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/136
### Other changes
* chore: widen the uv_build pin and drop the deprecated license classifier by @alDuncanson in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/131

## New Contributors
* @jayeeebee made their first contribution in https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/pull/134

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/alDuncanson/Handler/compare/v0.2.0...v0.3.0
